text:
emma_sales: Quick sync — Quasar POC (Acme FinTech). Sales needs a preflight check before demo tomorrow. Main asks: support for quasar-13b-int8 with 32k context? fallback options for memory spikes? rough pricing for ~1M tokens/month? any security questionnaire blockers (KMS / VPC / HSM)?

maria_solutions: Thanks — can you drop expected request shape? avg prompt length, concurrency, chat vs completion, KV cache usage?

emma_sales: Mostly chat (system + user). Avg prompt ~800 tokens, expected response ~1200 tokens. Peak concurrency ~40. They want prefix caching across sessions (long-lived chats).

li_engineer: quasar-13b-int8 is in catalog as `quasar-13b-int8-v1` — validated on A100 and T4. 32k context works but perf degrades; recommend quasar-32k-fp16 variant or a split-window approach. INT8 gives ~15% throughput improvement vs fp16, but increases memory variability.

zoe_se: If they require hard 32k SLO, suggest Dedicated (reserved GPUs) or explicit fallback routing to `quasar-32k-fp16` for long contexts. We can automate fallback but need sales to accept the potential cost delta.

raj_sre: We can enable prefix / KV cache for chat. Note: long-term session caching increases memory pressure — you'll need an autoscale floor. For concurrency=40, recommend min 4 GPUs on Dedicated with batching=auto.

anya_privsec: On security: KMS + VPC peering available. HSM is an enterprise add-on and will require legal/contract amendments. Send over the security questionnaire (SQQ) and I'll pre-fill the infra pieces.

emma_sales: I'll attach the SQQ now.

emma_sales: ```Attached: Acme_Quasar_SQQ_v1.pdf```

maria_solutions: For pricing, rough calc for 1M tokens: Hosted with quasar-13b-int8 ~ $0.0006 per generated token (ballpark). Dedicated reserved capacity can bring effective unit cost down (~$0.00032-$0.0004/token) depending on commit and utilization. I'll prepare two scenarios (hosted vs dedicated + fallback).

li_engineer: Quick POC config we'll test: ```yaml
model: quasar-13b-int8-v1
kv_cache: enabled
batching: auto
max_sequence: 32000
fallback_model: quasar-32k-fp16
routing: {latency_threshold_ms: 250}
```

zoe_se: :thumbsup: I'll build a demo script showing latency vs cost and failover behavior. Need 10 representative prompt/chat examples to show tail latency. Can you push them to the shared drive?

emma_sales: Uploading now to /drive/quasar_poc_samples. Also pinging legal for contract timelines.

anya_privsec: If they need SOC 2 report we can provide the latest. For HSM onboarding expect 4-6 weeks and an MSA addendum.

raj_sre: One more infra note: KV cache eviction TTL default is 24h — longer retention increases memory usage linearly. We should set expectations.

emma_sales: Client prefers 7-day retention. Is that realistic?

li_engineer: 7-day retention -> requires Dedicated with larger RAM footprint or NVM swap, and we'll need to size GPUs accordingly. I'll run numbers and post estimates by EOD.

zoe_se: I'll run an initial load test tomorrow morning. Can we schedule a quick handoff call at 10:00am PT to walk through the demo and failover plan?

emma_sales: Confirmed 10:00am PT. Thanks everyone :pray:
